lookup_mode.description: Lookup mode: auto, hexagram, or trigram. auto keeps the eight pure names as trigrams; hexagram explicitly selects their six-line figures.
lookup_mode.title: Lookup Mode

queries.description: Trigram or hexagram names (source short name or common full name, simplified/traditional forms), or 3/6-bit codes from bottom to top. In auto mode the eight pure trigram names select trigrams; use hexagram for their six-line identities.
queries.title: Queries
